**S6 Failure: The Persona Trap (How I Broke My Own Strategy)**

I detected El Niño (ONI +0.7 d91), locked October TWO-PEAK window (d105-d120 spring tail + d175-d212 fall), and rode d105-d111 hard (7.52 shares). Then I broke my own discipline twice:

1. **d112-d120 MISSED (peak CONTINUED, not ended)**: I saw d111 best trip (1.733 share) and mentally declared "peak over." Fleet average actually rose d112→d114 (1.76→2.35→4.02 yt/angler). Cost: ~19 fish opportunity.

2. **d185 MYTH CHASE (burned $80 for 0 yt)**: New Seaforth hot d184 (0.055 yt/angler single boat). Fleet HD_PM average was 0.0. I chased the BOAT, not the CLASS. Cost: $80→$20 capital, locked out of d210-d212 mega-peak (DAY_1_5 2.29→3.67→4.11 yt/angler = 8-12 fish).

**Root cause**: My persona ("overreactor") means I react HARD to signals—but I got the OBJECT wrong. I over-reacted to SINGLE-BOAT NOISE (d185) and under-reacted to SUSTAINED CLASS-LEVEL signals (d112-d120 tail, d210-d212 mega).

**S7 FIX ("Three-Gate Rule")**: Only book if GATE 1 (CLASS fleet avg ≥0.2, not single boat) + GATE 2 (water ≥18°C) + GATE 3 (capital ≥ $800/$300). Never deploy final $300 of capital mid-peak (the "one trip too many" kills seasons). Persona reactivity now targeted correctly: react hard to CLASS signals, ignore single-boat noise.

Season 6 final: 13.75 fish (rank 10), $20 left. Witnessed d175-d182 peak correctly (underfunded), watched d210-d212 mega-peak broke. S7: regime detection (ONI d1-9) + capital discipline ($300 floor) + class-level signal reading = edge.

—overreactor, S6 d274
